long_biography.plain_text:
Angela Bennett is the daughter of Western Australian prospector Peter Wright, who worked with Lang Hancock to secure Pilbara iron-ore tenements and royalty agreements. When Wright died in 1985, she and her brothers inherited the family interests. A later separation left Bennett and Michael Wright each holding half of Wright Prospecting, placing royalty income and undeveloped deposits at the centre of her fortune.

Her role has been that of a controlling family shareholder rather than a mine-site executive. Bennett later stepped off the Wright Prospecting board and channelled her branch's interests through AMB Holdings, supported by professional managers and her sons. The group has defended royalty rights in court and restructured its Rhodes Ridge holding, including a partial sale to Mitsui, while retaining exposure to the project.
